items.title: DMC Canada Branch Manager
items.detail: Appointed for 2025 alongside Jake “Vekked” Meyer and DJ Relik to run the DMC World DJ Championships in Canada.

items.title: Host, Technics DMC World DJ Championships 2025
items.detail: The 40th world final, in Tokyo, the first ever held in Asia. Billed as a host alongside Craze, DJ Babu and Darthreider.

items.title: Ran the 2026 DMC Canadian DJ Championships
items.detail: As branch manager: the national final at The Rec Room Roundhouse, Toronto, 6 September 2026.
